title: Degree-zero representative action formula implies local finite generation
statement: Let X be Noetherian, I a quasi-coherent ideal, F a coherent formal module [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module], A any graded sheaf algebra on B_n, and M a graded sheaf module on K_n [def-weil-pbc-formal-kernel-graded-pieces], [def-weil-pbc-graded-sheaf-structures]. Assume only the following degree-zero representative formula: for every n,U, a in I^n(U), s in K_0(U), and t in F_(n+1)(U) reducing to s, the inclusion of M.act n 0 of the class of a and s equals a times t. Then M.IsLocallyGeneratedInDegreeZero. This constructs neither A nor M and requires no action formula in positive module degree.

source.place: Lemma 087Z, affine proof via Lemma 087W and Section 0EHN; constituent of the parent existence proof, expanded in the Lean docstring.

proof.text: Restrict to an affine neighbourhood U of a given point. The affine equivalence gives a finite completion module N with projections having kernels I^r N. Affine ideal-power and quotient-section formulas and the tilde/global-sections adjunction identify B_n and K_n with the sheaves associated to I^n/I^(n+1) and I^n N/I^(n+1)N. This includes K_0=N/IN.

Choose a finite family generating N/IN and lift it to N. The completed-module associated-graded generator theorem supplies coefficient representatives in I^n for every element of I^n N modulo I^(n+1)N. Their quotient classes multiply the fixed degree-zero generators. Apply the assumed degree-zero action formula to the projection of each fixed lift to F_(n+1) to identify these products with M.act n 0.

The resulting finite-sum degree-n map is an epimorphism after tilde, which preserves quotient epimorphisms as a left adjoint. For an arbitrary smaller open V, section y and point q in V, sheaf-local surjectivity supplies W inside V containing q and coefficient sections on W expressing y. The fixed sections on U, these W and their coefficients satisfy exactly IsLocallyGeneratedInDegreeZero, with HEq accounting for n+0=n.

theorem formalKernel_graded_action_local_generators {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X]
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (F : CoherentFormalModule X I)
    (A : GradedSheafAlgebra (formalAssociatedGradedPiece I))
    (M : GradedSheafModule A (formalKernelPiece F))
    (hact : ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : X.Opens)
      (a : (Scheme.idealSheafPower I.toModulesι n).1.val.obj (op U))
      (s : (formalKernelPiece F 0).val.obj (op U))
      (t : (F.obj.obj (op n)).val.obj (op U)),
      (F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.zero_le n)).op).val.app (op U) t =
        (formalKernelι F 0).val.app (op U) s →
      (formalKernelι F n).val.app (op U)
        (M.act n 0 U ((formalAssociatedGradedπ I n).val.app (op U) a) s) =
          (@id Γ(X, U) ((Scheme.idealSheafPower I.toModulesι n).2.val.app (op U) a)) • t) :
    M.IsLocallyGeneratedInDegreeZero
